name: Browser
note: Many people set a search engine as their browser's home page, which is why the two seem to be one thing

name: Search engine
purpose: Keeps an index of web pages and finds pages in it — and is itself a website
note: It is reached THROUGH a browser, the way a shop is reached through a door

name: Spider
purpose: Walks web pages and builds the index a search engine keeps
note: Nobody uses a spider directly; it works for the search engine that owns it

name: Operating system
purpose: Runs a device and the programs on it

name: Device
purpose: The physical thing you hold or sit in front of

name: Word processor
purpose: Writes and formats documents that are meant to be read as pages
note: Confused with the office suite it usually arrives in

name: Spreadsheet
purpose: Holds numbers in a grid and calculates with them
note: The second thing in nearly every office suite, and the reason the suite is not a word processor

name: Office suite
purpose: Bundles several programs that are sold and installed as one — typically a word processor, a spreadsheet and a presentation program
note: The whole point of having this type: a suite is not any of the things inside it, and that is what makes „ist MS-Office ein Textprogramm?“ a real question

name: Messenger
purpose: Carries messages between people who each have it installed
note: Three of them in this inventory from three different makers — a good place to see that the maker is not the thing
